notes.title: Return to Shironagasu Island Major Update Announcement
notes.notes:
We have conducted a major update for 'Return to Shironagasu Island', introducing the following new features and content:​

Implemented Japanese voice acting across all languages.​
Added a configuration option to the top menu.​
Enabled voice playback in the backlog.​
After clearing the game, promotional videos can now be viewed in the CG library.​
Added several new scenes.​

Note: Save data has been refreshed, so previous data cannot be used. You can force skip by pressing the Control key on your keyboard. If you encounter any bugs, please report them to us.
If you wish to play using your previous save data, right-click the game, go to Properties, and select the old2 version from the Betas tab.
If it doesn't apply correctly, try uninstalling and reinstalling the game. (Your save data will be preserved.)
If you reinstall the old2 version, a bug may occur where save data appears to be empty. However, the save data itself is still intact. Clicking on an empty thumbnail will resume the game from the corresponding scene.
If the empty thumbnail bothers you, please load the save and then overwrite it to update the display.

notes.title: Return to Shironagasu Island, Voice is implemented in the Japanese version & not
notes.notes:
Return to Shironagasu Island, voice acting voices have been implemented in the Japanese version.
Now you can enjoy the game with voices.
Thank you for your cooperation.
[b]Please note that save data is not compatible between the voice version and the previous version.
Therefore, if you wish to continue to use your previous save data
From the properties that appear after right-clicking on the game
Click on "Beta" and in the drop-down list, select
old_version" in the drop-down list.
You will then be able to continue playing the game using your saved data. [/b]
Currently, voices are only available in the Japanese version of the game.
This is due to licensing issues, and as soon as we are able to raise the budget for a new version, we will implement voices in other languages as well.
We are planning to add voices to other languages as soon as we have the budget to do so.

notes.title: Implemented an old game BGM version.
notes.notes:
You can now play older versions of the game.
Right-click Return to Shironagasu Island from the library and select Properties. Select old_bgm_version from the beta and the old BGM version will be downloaded.
Please note, however, that if you have saved data from a newer game, some errors may occur when playing with the old BGM game.

notes.title: Animation Update
notes.notes: Implemented eye and mouth animations for all standing character pictures.

notes.title: The English version has been officially released.
notes.notes:
As the English proofreading work has been completed, the English version has been officially released.
If you are already playing the English early access version, you can change it to the official version by logging out and logging in.
The saved data of the early access version is not compatible with the official version.

As a remedy for those who are playing English early access and are in the middle of a game, we distribute saved data.
(Pre-gameplay users do not need this data)

C:/Users/username/AppData/Roaming /
Please insert the folder downloaded from the URL below into the above folder.
(Insert the extracted [return to shironagasu island ver 2] folder.)
[url=https://bit.ly/3kNTmLm]https://bit.ly/3kNTmLm[/url]

The saved data is now reflected.
Note that AppData is a hidden folder.
Please note that distribution of saved data is limited to one month.

Also, if you have any questions about the introduction method, I would appreciate it if you could comment on this news.
Thank you in advance.


HYOGO ONIMUSHI

notes.title: I have finished translating the English version of the game.
notes.notes:
We have completed the translation of the main and extra scenarios.
Now you can play the entire game in English.
The extra scenario is displayed after finishing the staff roll of the main story.
You can now play the entire game, but the official release of the English version will be after checking for typos and omissions.
The work will probably be finished within ten days.
Thank you in advance.

HYOGO ONIMUSHI

notes.title: Release of the English version for early access.
notes.notes:
I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
After proofreading, I released the English version.
(Updates are applied when you log in after logging out.)
However, because of delays in grammar checking, the Extra scenario is implemented later.
(In this version, clearing the game does not display the Extra scenario.)
Think of this as an early access version.
Therefore, it does not indicate that the English version has been officially supported yet.
There may be some typos left, but the translation itself should be much better.
We plan to fix minor mistakes such as typos by updating in the next few days.

[strike]We will start our 30% off sale at 18:00 on September 4, 2020. [/strike]
Sorry, I misunderstood the time in Los Angeles ......。
The sale will begin on September 5, 2020 at 10:00 LA time.

Save data may be distributed when the final version including Extra is released.
Data stored in the game should work in the final version, but errors can occur.
In this case, use the save data that will be distributed later.
Thank you in advance.

HYOGO ONIMUSHI

notes.title: A major update was made to the Japanese and simplified Chinese versions.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36456508/f287a68ab2e7b61184247061a780e7b47a20361e.jpg[/img]

The major changes in this update are:.
・Double resolution (1600 px x 1200 px)
・Window size can be freely changed
・Add 6 Save Slots
・Improved visibility of backlog
・Minor corrections to avoid stress in play
・bug fix
Skip with the F key.

These changes have been applied to the later English releases.

Originally, we planned to release the English version at the same time with the large update of Japanese and Chinese simplified characters in the middle of June, but we will do the update first because the proofreading is delayed.
The delay in English proofreading is due to the double check and we have received a guarantee that the proofreading will be completed at the end of June.
Therefore, the English version is scheduled to be released in early July.
Sorry for the delay in the release.
We plan to implement the Steam trading card in July.

Hyogo ONIMUSHI

Top illustration:Chiku(Daiichi yutakasou)
